<@&1424461167883194418> Model updates — 2026-10-07

### 🆕 New
- 🧠 **GPT-6.1 Sol** (OpenAI) — image input, reasoning, and tool calling
- 🧠 **Ling 3.1 Flash** (inclusionAI) — reasoning and tool calling
- 🧠 **Liquid D1** (Liquid AI) — typed decisions
- 🎨 **FLUX.3 Image** (Black Forest Labs) — generation and multi-reference editing
- 🎨 **Seedream 5.0 Flash** (ByteDance) — generation and editing at 1K or 2K
- 🎬 **Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite** (xAI) — video from text or a start image
- 🎬 **HeyGen Video 1** (HeyGen) — video with synchronized audio
- 🔊 **ElevenLabs v4 · v4 Turbo** (ElevenLabs) — text-to-speech with character timestamps

### 🗑️ Removed
- `microsoft/mai-image-2.5-flash` (image)
- `community/sharktide/inferenceport-ai-lightning-text-v2` (text)
- `community/vendouple/claude-sonnet-5.5:stable` (text)
- `community/vendouple/claude-opus-5.5:stable` (text)
- Additional community text and image models; see the changelog.

### ⬇️ Price cuts
- 🧠 Text: GPT 6 Sol stable (~25%) · Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite (~5%) · community GLM 5.3 Flash, supercharge, MetraxAI & Qwen3.8 27B Paid (~10%)
- 🔢 Embeddings: Qwen3 Embedding 8B (prompt-text rate −90%)

### ⬆️ Price increases
- 🧠 Text: Nemotron 3 Ultra (~10% output) · Qwen3 Coder 30B & Code Pair (~130% output) · Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Search (~5%) · community DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 (400%) · community Gemma 4 31B (~10%)
